title: Picset AI 图片连接器配置
description: 请输入在 Picset AI 用户中心创建的密钥。该密钥仅由 WorkBuddy 保存在本机用户目录，并在连接 Picset AI 图片连接器时作为 Authorization 请求头发送。
descriptionEn: Enter the Agent SK created in Picset AI user center. WorkBuddy stores this SK only in the local user directory and sends it to Picset AI MCP as an Authorization header.
docLabel: 创建 Picset AI 密钥
docLabelEn: Create a Picset AI Agent SK
